data.consensus_view: The consensus wrongly treated a sub-$85 billion DeFiLlama TVL print as only a roughly 31% outcome because the threshold was insufficiently anchored in current data.
data.failure_story: The missing-anchor premise was false: total DeFi TVL was already $88.54B, only $3.54B (4.0%) above the settlement threshold. The model’s relevant comparison is not a speculative macro scenario but the existing trajectory: TVL was down 3.8% in seven days and 4.1% in 30 days. A further decline comparable to either observed rate would put TVL at about $85.18B or $84.91B, respectively. The other view discounted this as a volatile two-week move; that was reasonable only if the decline reversed. Instead, continued risk-off conditions alongside already-falling chain TVL left no buffer for ordinary weekly variation, and TVL printed below $85B before November 1.
